lesson: The creative midfielder was covered in second place, which preserved a positive score. First-goal slates should continue to include the highest-minute attacking midfielder rather than concentrating only on centre-forwards.

Joao Neves was another omitted midfield runner in a first-scorer market. Even when a famous striker dominates attention, reserve a top-five slot for a starting central midfielder who regularly arrives in the box.

A broad forward slate captured Wissa at 25 percent and produced a useful positive score. Where two forwards share the line, avoid giving the older historical scorer too large an edge over the current Premier League attacker.

The Boston narrative and contract-mechanism inference were given too much weight without a directly reported negotiation. Gotham was covered through a recognized alias, but only at nine percent; club-move forecasts need more weight on established elite destinations and exact official naming.
Daniel Munoz extends the repeated run of attacking defenders and wing-backs scoring first. When a fullback has an advanced national-team role, include him even at the expense of a fifth forward.
